Added && guard — was executing without prerequisite check RULE: Validate prerequisites before executing logic. Check that DOM elements exist, APIs are loaded, and data is present before using them.

Documentation compression removed critical UI layout and z-index specifications that developers depend on, causing potential layout violations and stacking context conflicts in refactored components RULE: Never compress or remove safety-critical documentation during refactors; maintain a separate immutable reference document or enforce documentation review gates before deletion

External API image URLs from genspark.ai were failing, requiring migration to locally served static webp files to ensure reliable image loading. RULE: Avoid hardcoding external API URLs in production code; use a configuration layer or CDN with fallback mechanisms for image assets.

External image URLs from genspark.ai became unreliable, causing broken image displays and dependency on third-party service availability. RULE: Always self-host critical assets and avoid external CDN/API dependencies for content delivery; use local static files for images.

SVG icons with colored text/strokes rendered invisible when parent color style didn't provide sufficient contrast against background, requiring explicit dark fill colors (#0a0a0f) for nested elements instead of relying on currentColor inheritance RULE: Establish a contrast validation rule for SVG icon designs: verify that all nested elements either explicitly define fill/stroke colors or test curr

Personalization features (Qing references, emoji animations, streak/achievement systems) were tightly coupled to UI components and required coordinated removal across multiple i18n locales and HTML files, risking incomplete cleanup and broken references. Avatar component descriptions and multilingual names were inconsistent with actual visual asset properties (shutter shades horizontal slats and asymmetrical hair styling), causing mismatched user expectations RULE: Implement automated validation that cross-references component metadata descriptions against actual asset visual properties and regenerate descriptions from asset inspection on each bui

Character visual specifications were inconsistent across scenes; Panthera's wing color was incorrectly specified as gold instead of dark navy-blue/purple, and scene 04 action sequence was outdated. RULE: Implement automated validation rules that cross-reference character specifications across all scenes and flag color/appearance inconsistencies against a canonical character reference sheet.

Language toggle buttons were blocked by overlaying elements due to insufficient z-index (100) and missing pointer-events declarations, preventing clicks on mobile and desktop. RULE: Always explicitly set pointer-events and use sufficiently high z-index values (9999+) for interactive fixed-position UI elements, with mobile-specific repositioning to avoid viewport obstruction.

Documentation and configuration files drifted from actual codebase state, causing stale references and metadata inconsistencies that would mislead AI agents during onboarding. RULE: Implement automated validation checks (--validate flag) that run on every commit to detect and prevent drift between documentation, configuration files, and actual codebase state.

Navigation menu structure was not updated to reflect the relocation of PVP Diary from TCG Play section to Guild section, causing inconsistent information architecture between page content and navigation. RULE: Implement automated tests that verify navigation menu items match actual page locations and section categorizations across the entire site.

Incomplete DOM removal left a dangling closing tag and orphaned CSS rules without their selector, breaking HTML structure and leaving dead style declarations. RULE: Use automated DOM tree validation and CSS rule validation tools in build pipeline to detect orphaned closing tags and selectors without matching opening elements.

Added typeof !== undefined guard — variable was used before definition. Also: Added missing return statement — function was returning undefined; Added || [] fallback — was calling array method on undefined RULE: Use typeof check before accessing globals that may not be loaded yet. This often indicates a load-order dependency.

Missing translations for new quote fields (meiLinQuote, kevinQuote) in Thai language caused incomplete i18n implementation across three supported languages. RULE: Enforce translation completeness validation in CI/CD to require all i18n keys present across all supported language objects before merge.

Event listener was registered on wrong event name 'nw-lang-changed' instead of 'nw-lang-change', causing language toggle functionality to fail silently RULE: Use constants for event names and validate emitter/listener pairs match through integration tests or type-safe event systems

Card carousel failed to display because image paths and data source were hardcoded to outdated locations instead of versioned endpoints RULE: Externalize API endpoints and resource paths to configuration files with version management rather than hardcoding them in source code
Decks were built and hands dealt during init() (page load), RULE: Validate prerequisites before executing logic. Check that DOM elements exist, APIs are loaded, and data is present before using them.
Stats grid was overlapping on small screens due to fixed px positions RULE: Test every UI change at 320px, 768px, and 1024px. Add @media breakpoints for layouts that break at different screen sizes.
.arena-container was position:fixed with no overflow, RULE: overflow:hidden on a parent silently clips children that extend beyond bounds. Check all child elements before adding it.
Wrapped code in try-catch — was crashing on error RULE: Wrap external calls (DOM, fetch, JSON.parse, localStorage) in try-catch. Unhandled exceptions crash the entire function.
Removed overflow:hidden to fix clipping RULE: overflow:hidden on a parent silently clips children. Use overflow:visible or overflow:auto to allow content to extend.

DEV_MODE constant was referenced in forge.html but never defined, causing ReferenceError when code attempted to check the flag; battle.html's conditional skip-mode logic was removed and replaced with unconditional auto-start, breaking the ability to show the start screen during normal operation. Mobile touch events were not properly handled due to missing touchend event listeners, overflow constraints prevented scrolling, and z-index layering blocked touch interactions on iOS RULE: Always add touchend event listeners alongside click handlers for mobile, use overflow-y: auto with -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch, and ensure interactive elements have z-index above background decorations

iOS audio context requires initialization during a user gesture, but the previous implementation only called initForgeAudio() without resuming the suspended AudioContext, causing audio playback to fail on iOS devices. RULE: Always resume AudioContext during user interaction handlers on mobile platforms, and verify context state before attempting playback.

Watermark overlays with absolute positioning and fixed z-index were clipping into photo corners and appearing as unprofessional brand artifacts; ambient audio system was unnecessary feature bloat. RULE: Avoid absolute/fixed positioning for decorative overlays on dynamic content; use CSS containment or validate visual bounds during design review.

Added setTimeout(500ms) — timing/race condition fix. Also: Added setTimeout(300ms) — timing/race condition fix; Added string fallback — was showing undefined/null in UI RULE: If you need setTimeout to fix a bug, you have a race condition. Find the root cause (missing callback, wrong event, load order) instead of papering over it with delays.

Card gallery failed to display 108 cards because image paths were hardcoded to incorrect directory and data source was a static array instead of dynamic JSON file RULE: Use configuration files or data attributes for resource paths instead of hardcoding them, and load dynamic data from external sources rather than embedding static arrays

Hardcoded member data in TypeScript was replaced with JSON source-of-truth, but the data structure and CP tracking logic needed to be migrated to keep the roster synchronized RULE: Establish a single source of truth for data by loading all member information from JSON configuration files rather than duplicating it in application code

Added missing await — was ignoring promise result. Also: Added missing return statement — function was returning undefined; Added 2 optional chaining operator(s) — null reference fix RULE: Every async function call that returns data you use must be awaited. Missing await causes race conditions where code uses stale/undefined values.

Removing rarity gem styling with `display: none !important` while keeping HTML elements in DOM causes unnecessary DOM bloat and potential CSS specificity conflicts with future style rules. RULE: Remove unused HTML elements and CSS rules entirely rather than hiding them with display:none; audit DOM for dead code during refactoring.

Ship name was misspelled as 'RegginA' (double g) in the HTML title and heading, causing inconsistency with the correct spelling 'REGINA' used elsewhere in navigation and branding. RULE: Implement automated spell-checking and brand name validation in CI/CD pipeline to catch misspellings of critical identifiers before deployment.

Variable `lastLogBalance` was declared after `updateUI()` function definition but called within it, causing undefined reference errors when `updateUI()` executed before the declaration was reached. RULE: Hoist all variables used by functions to the top of their scope before any function definitions or calls that depend on them.

The 'zakum' page was missing from the staticPages array, causing routing requests to /zakum to fail despite the HTML file existing in the public directory. RULE: Maintain a single source of truth for static page routes and validate that all public HTML files are registered in the routing array during build or test time.

Added missing return statement — function was returning undefined. Also: Added missing return statement — function was returning undefined; Added missing return statement — function was returning undefined RULE: Functions that compute values must return them. Missing return causes undefined results and silent failures.

Fixed Floating Action Button (FAB) positioning that was blocking the currency bar by moving it from right to left side and adjusting vertical offset from 24px to 50px. RULE: Test fixed-position UI elements against all page regions during development to detect unintended overlaps with other fixed/sticky elements.

Added missing return statement — function was returning undefined. Also: Added missing return statement — function was returning undefined; Added && guard — was executing without prerequisite check RULE: Functions that compute values must return them. Missing return causes undefined results and silent failures.

Auto-initialization guard added without clearing the initialized flag on page transitions, causing nav to skip re-initialization when navigating between pages. RULE: Reset initialization flags on page navigation events or use instance-based initialization scoped to DOM elements rather than global singletons.

Rotation prompt overlay was blocking game initialization on certain mobile devices by forcing portrait orientation detection before game logic could load. RULE: Defer device orientation checks until after core game initialization completes, or make orientation handling non-blocking with graceful fallbacks.

Card art images were being cropped with object-fit: cover, hiding portions of the full artwork that should be visible in the print template. RULE: Use object-fit: contain for images that must display completely, and reserve object-fit: cover only when intentional cropping to fill a container is desired.

Member name was incorrectly stored as '納踢祝著' instead of '紈稀祝著', causing data mismatch with the custom avatar asset filename 'member-wanxizhuozhu.png' RULE: Validate that member identifiers (names or IDs) match their corresponding asset filenames through automated tests or a centralized member registry

New UI Guardian script injected into HTML without dependency ordering verification, risking execution before required DOM elements or prerequisite scripts are loaded. RULE: Verify all script dependencies are loaded before injection and document required load-order constraints in commit messages.

Mobile layout used fixed max-height constraints on watchlist panel causing horizontal scroll content to be clipped and inaccessible on smaller screens. RULE: Use overflow-x: auto with flex layout and remove max-height constraints on containers that need horizontal scrolling on mobile viewports.

Missing favicon link in HTML head caused browser to request a default favicon.ico, resulting in 404 errors and missing visual branding. RULE: Ensure all static assets referenced in HTML templates have corresponding files in the public directory and are explicitly linked in the document head.

Previous pixelated equipment images did not match MapleStory's 3D golden aesthetic, causing visual inconsistency with game style expectations. RULE: Establish and enforce visual style guidelines for game assets before implementation, with design review checkpoints before asset finalization.

Added missing await — was ignoring promise result. Also: Wrapped code in try-catch — was crashing on error; Modified conditional logic RULE: Every async function call that returns data you use must be awaited. Missing await causes race conditions where code uses stale/undefined values.

Added overflow:hidden — may clip child elements. Also: Added overflow:hidden — may clip child elements; Added display:none — element was incorrectly visible RULE: overflow:hidden on a parent silently clips children that extend beyond bounds. Check all child elements before adding it.

Card and pack container elements were undersized and misaligned on mobile viewports, causing poor visibility and layout centering failures. RULE: Establish minimum viewport-independent sizing constraints and test responsive breakpoints at actual device dimensions before deployment.

Script load order caused bgm.js to execute before wallet FAB initialization, blocking the wallet button in the floating action bar. RULE: Establish explicit script dependency ordering or use module imports instead of defer-loaded scripts that have side effects on DOM elements.

Added 1 optional chaining operator(s) — null reference fix. Also: Added string fallback — was showing undefined/null in UI RULE: Always use optional chaining (?.) when accessing properties on objects that may be undefined, especially DOM queries and API responses.

Function name mismatch: battle.html called setupStartButton() which no longer exists, should call initStartScreen() instead RULE: Use IDE refactoring tools to rename functions across all files, or add compile-time checks to catch undefined function references

Wrapped code in try-catch — was crashing on error. Also: Wrapped code in try-catch — was crashing on error RULE: Wrap external calls (DOM, fetch, JSON.parse, localStorage) in try-catch. Unhandled exceptions crash the entire function.
Switched from string concat to template literal — concatenation bug RULE: Use template literals instead of string concatenation. Concatenation bugs (missing spaces, wrong order) are harder to spot.
Pack total size = card size, but pack has seal + body RULE: CSS value changes should be tested at multiple screen sizes. Check for inherited properties and specificity conflicts.

Market — Free Trading System:

CSS overflow: hidden property clipped the badge content, displaying only partial text ('ewBadge' instead of 'NEW!' or 'ใหม่!'), and language changes weren't synchronized because the guide didn't listen to language-change events from the navigation component. RULE: Always test badge/tooltip overflow behavior with multiple languages and text lengths; use overflow: visible or clip-path for UI element

Image selector specificity changed from `.deck-card img` to `.deck-card img.card-image`, potentially breaking styling for images without the `card-image` class and causing layout shift from `object-fit: cover` to `object-fit: contain` with height calculation. RULE: Maintain backward compatibility by either keeping the original selector or explicitly applying the new class to all affected images; t

Card counter and filter buttons overlapped due to insufficient vertical spacing; counter positioned at bottom: 160px while filters started at bottom: 108px, causing z-index collision despite counter having z-index: 50. RULE: Maintain a spacing buffer between fixed-position elements and document their z-index hierarchy; use CSS custom properties to define stacking context layers and minimum gaps be

Pixel grid dimensions and gap sizes were changed from 8x8 to 7x7 with reduced gaps, breaking the original emblem's visual pattern and requiring color class refactoring from semantic names (orange, dark-orange) to generic identifiers (c1-c6). RULE: Extract pixel grid dimensions and color palettes into configuration constants with documented specifications to prevent accidental layout breakage durin

Animation timing constants were unrealistic for live operational data display, causing UI ticker rotations to update faster than actual AIS satellite observation cadences, creating false impression of data freshness. RULE: Validate animation intervals against real-world data source refresh rates and document the physical constraint (e.g., satellite pass frequency) that justifies each timing consta

YouTube IFrame API script was added but the player initialization code that uses the API was removed or not shown, causing the YouTube player to fail to load because YT global object methods are called on an uninitialized div. RULE: Ensure API initialization code executes after the external script loads; use window.onYouTubeIframeAPIReady callback or defer player setup until API is ready.

CSS styling for pack visual design was completely replaced with image-based approach, removing gradient backgrounds and animations that may have been relied upon by dependent code or visual regression tests. RULE: Maintain backward-compatible CSS fallbacks when replacing visual designs, and verify all dependent selectors and animations are updated consistently across the codebase.

Art images were displayed with object-fit: contain, causing them to not fill the card frame completely and appear smaller than intended, breaking the professional TCG card aesthetic. RULE: Use object-fit: cover with explicit aspect-ratio constraints when designing image containers that should fill their frame completely, and document the intended visual behavior in design specs.

CSS cascade conflicts and missing positioning context caused card images to not fill their containers; duplicate selectors with conflicting constraints (max-width/max-height) prevented proper sizing. RULE: Use CSS specificity hierarchy and avoid conflicting size constraints on the same element; prefer absolute positioning with inset over width/height when filling a container.

Hero banner layout was vertically centered on all screen sizes, causing the RegginA emblem and content to be misaligned on mobile devices; N emblem SVG was rendering with standard proportions instead of thick blocky pixelated style. RULE: Always implement mobile-first CSS with explicit media queries for layout changes, testing viewport-specific positioning before deployment.

Mobile autoplay policy blocked unmuted video playback, but the silent fallback lacked visual feedback (loading spinner), causing users to see a blank black screen with no indication the video was loading. RULE: Always provide visual feedback (loader/spinner) when initiating async operations that may be silently blocked by browser policies, especially on mobile platforms.

Removing CSS animations from loader elements reduced visual feedback during page load, potentially causing perceived performance degradation or user confusion about loading state. RULE: Measure actual FPS impact with animations enabled before removing visual feedback; consider animation-timing-function optimization or requestAnimationFrame throttling instead of removal.

YouTube iframe was visible on mobile, allowing users to zoom and interact with the player instead of audio-only playback; viewport meta tag lacked zoom constraints. RULE: Always restrict viewport zoom on mobile-first applications and hide non-essential media players using off-screen positioning (bottom: -9999px) rather than display:none to preserve audio functionality.

Mobile CSS override positioned language switcher at bottom instead of top-right, causing it to overlap content or appear in wrong location on mobile viewports. RULE: Test responsive layouts across all breakpoints to ensure mobile overrides don't contradict the primary design intent; use mobile-first CSS approach with additive overrides rather than position reversals.

Ship animation durations were not calibrated to real-world distances and speeds, causing visual misrepresentation of transit times relative to actual nautical miles and cruise speeds. RULE: Establish a conversion matrix between visual units and real-world measurements (nm, knots, hours) and validate all animation durations against this calibration before deployment.

Currency identifier 'diamond' was renamed to 'nwg' across CSS classes and data objects to implement a 3-tier currency system, but the old identifier remained in use causing pricing display mismatches. RULE: Use find-and-replace with full-codebase verification or implement a currency constant that is referenced in both CSS and data layers to prevent identifier drift.

Viewport meta tag lacked zoom constraints and CSS sizing rules didn't fill viewport completely, allowing users to zoom out below 1.0x scale and exposing borders/empty space. RULE: Always specify minimum-scale, maximum-scale, and user-scalable in viewport meta tags alongside CSS rules that ensure html/body fill 100% of viewport dimensions with overflow containment.

YouTube player container changed from 1x1px hidden to 280x158px visible, breaking the intended hidden BGM player behavior and potentially causing layout shifts or unintended visibility. RULE: Use CSS `display: none` or `visibility: hidden` with explicit comments when hiding UI elements, rather than relying on minimal dimensions that can be accidentally modified.

Truncation logic was removed from card name display without ensuring CSS constraints could handle all name lengths, causing potential layout overflow on cards with very long names. RULE: When removing text truncation, verify that CSS constraints (max-width, max-height, word-wrap) are sufficient for the longest possible input before removing programmatic limits.

Language switcher was positioned as a floating fixed element outside the navbar, causing z-index stacking conflicts and layout overlap issues when moved inside the navbar structure. RULE: Establish a component hierarchy rule where UI elements with z-index dependencies must be siblings or parent-child in the DOM tree, not scattered across unrelated containers.

Pixel emblem styling used multiple discrete color classes that were replaced with a single gradient class, breaking the visual appearance when class names changed from c1-c6 to 'fill' RULE: Maintain backward compatibility when refactoring CSS class names by keeping old selectors functional or updating all DOM elements and styles atomically in a single commit

Missing i18n translation keys for zh (Traditional Chinese) and th (Thai) languages caused incomplete localization coverage across 113 UI strings in the Wyckoff educational page RULE: Implement automated i18n key validation that enforces all supported languages have matching key counts before deployment, and use build-time checks to flag missing translations

CSS display property changed from block to flex without adjusting parent container layout expectations, potentially causing text centering and spacing inconsistencies in the pixel-title element. RULE: Test layout changes across viewport sizes and verify that display property modifications maintain visual consistency with existing parent/sibling constraints.

Desktop flex-direction:column rule persisted in mobile viewport, causing photo height to expand beyond intended 120px and overlap title/body text in the 2-column grid layout. RULE: Always explicitly override conflicting parent layout properties (flex-direction, display) in mobile breakpoints rather than relying on new rules to implicitly supersede them.

Velocity sensitivity constant of 200 caused excessive scroll acceleration, making the deck instantly jump to the end instead of smoothly animating through cards during swipe gestures. RULE: Validate physics constants against expected behavior ranges through integration tests that measure animation duration and final position against user input velocity.

Wallet page script dependency loaded without defer attribute before other deferred scripts, causing potential race condition where nw-wallet.js executes before DOM is ready or before dependent styles are applied. RULE: Always use defer attribute on all script tags or ensure synchronous scripts have no dependencies on deferred scripts and DOM readiness.

CSS overflow:hidden property was clipping the pack image content, and the .pack-bag-seal overlay was visually blocking the pack image display. RULE: Audit CSS overflow properties on container elements to ensure they don't unintentionally clip child content; use transparent backgrounds and clip-path for precise visual effects instead of overflow:hidden.

Pack bag 3D scene had incorrect perspective origin and missing flexbox layout properties, causing poor visibility and misaligned positioning of the 3D container and instruction elements. RULE: Always pair 3D perspective transforms with explicit flex layout properties and verify perspective-origin coordinates match intended visual center point.

Card frames had inconsistent border-radius values (14px vs 12px) and complex gradient borders that created visual misalignment and improper corner visibility across nested elements. RULE: Define border-radius values as CSS custom properties at the root level and reuse them consistently across all nested elements to prevent visual misalignment.

Card and pack elements used inconsistent viewport units (vh vs vw) causing incorrect scaling on mobile devices where viewport width differs significantly from height. RULE: Use consistent viewport units (vw for width-based layouts) across all screen sizes and always test responsive behavior on actual mobile devices with varying aspect ratios.

YouTube IFrame API script tag was removed before the player initialization code that depends on it, causing the YT global object to be undefined when the player attempts to instantiate. RULE: Ensure all external API dependencies are loaded before any code that consumes them, or verify the global object exists before use with defensive checks.

Music button logic was conditional on player visibility state, causing it to show the player instead of toggling music when already playing, breaking the expected toggle behavior. RULE: Ensure toggle operations have single, unconditional code paths; separate concerns like visibility management from core toggle logic into distinct handlers.

Duplicate overlay hide call was executing unconditionally after animation completion, skipping the swipe handler that should occur between animation end and overlay removal. RULE: Ensure cleanup operations only execute in error paths or after all dependent handlers have completed; use Promise chains or async/await to enforce ordering.

Pack bag layout used absolute positioning for seal and body elements without proper flex container structure, causing seal to overlap body content and preventing proper height distribution. RULE: Use flex container with flex-direction and relative positioning for child elements instead of absolute positioning when parent uses flexbox.

HTML content with inline tags was rendered as plain text instead of parsed HTML because data-i18n attribute doesn't support HTML rendering, requiring data-i18n-html for proper markup interpretation. RULE: Use data-i18n-html attribute when i18n strings contain HTML markup like
or , and data-i18n only for plain text content.

Fixed overlay with pointer-events:auto captured all touch events before reaching interactive buttons below it, making skip button unresponsive on mobile. RULE: Set pointer-events:none on fixed overlays and use invisible tap-target layers above content to intercept only necessary interactions while allowing buttons to receive events.

Body overflow style remained set to 'hidden' after navigation reinject during language toggle, preventing scroll on iOS due to stale DOM state not being cleaned up. RULE: Always reset CSS overrides and component state flags when completely removing and recreating DOM elements, especially for mobile-critical properties like overflow.

Roster data was updated with incorrect CP values and member information that caused inconsistencies between previousCP and current member stats, requiring revert to previous valid state. RULE: Implement validation rules that verify CP progression is monotonic and member stats are internally consistent before committing data updates.

Countdown timing was misaligned with animation duration, causing the 3-2-1-FIGHT display to appear before the 0.8s animation completed, creating visual desynchronization. Simulation function was changed to always run instead of only as fallback, causing continuous price drift that accumulates beyond realistic bounds and diverges from actual API data.
